$comment: Blind labels for the instrument-v2 validation sheet. Rated from segment TEXT ONLY — no personas, citations, kinds or classifier verdicts — by a rater who is not the classifier's author. y! = circumstantial and coverable by a P/B/J id; y? = circumstantial but nothing in the declared surface can cover it; n = clinical or protocol knowledge where first person is grammar; ? = abstained, excluded from scoring. The five decision rules the rater committed BEFORE scoring are in docs/okf/concepts/instrument-v2.md; disagreements are adjudicated against those rules, never re-argued per segment.
segments_are_indices_into: the hash-shuffled 53-segment sheet built from tests/cassettes/narration_battery.json
